body.statement: For the worked binary input, the deterministic run performs ancestor restriction to \(Y^{*}=\{Y\}\), computes \(D^{*}=\{Y\}\) and a closure containing \(S,A\), enters Algorithm 2, exhausts every line-7 candidate, and records \(\operatorname{LGSFailA2NoCandidate}(D^{*},C)\).  Its residual verifier then accepts the rational-affine contrast \(d=(-4,-1,0,3)\) on \(0<b<1/32\).  At \(b=1/64\) the two canonical models have selector support exactly \(H=\{0,1\}\), the same complete observed law including \(W_0,Z_0\), strictly positive admissible cells, and target probabilities \(1/2\) and \(63/128\).
body.proof_tex:
We first reduce the deterministic cases.  In the target LS-SWIG, \(A\) and \(S\) are fixed and \(W_0,Z_0\) have no children, so the observed random ancestor set of \(Y\) is \(Y^{*}=\{Y\}\), with sole district \(D^{*}=\{Y\}\).  In the unfixed selector graph, the bidirected paths induced by the shared roots \(U_0\) and \(R_0\) force the reachable closure of \(D^{*}\) to contain \(A\) and \(S\).  Thus \(C\ne D^{*}\) and \(S\in C\), so the unique case function enters Algorithm 2.  Its nonempty serious-child choice is the gate-forced \(A\) at \(\bar s=1\).  The only district that can contain \(D^{*}\) is computed from the LS-SWIG.  The path opened by the common root \(R_0\) connects \(S\) to the response of \(Y\) under the stated conditioning, so the line-7 d-separation condition fails; any remaining encoded triple either has empty serious set or fails the independently computed reachability test.  Hence the finite scan exhausts and, by input determinacy, returns exactly \(\operatorname{LGSFailA2NoCandidate}(D^{*},C)\), followed by its residual task.

It remains to verify the residual candidate.  Let the affected baseline row success probabilities be
\[
 r=(3/4,1/4,1/4,3/4),\qquad d=(-4,-1,0,3).
\]
On all binary response tables \(f\), put
\[
 \pi_0(f)=\prod_j r_j^{f(j)}(1-r_j)^{1-f(j)},\qquad
 \delta(f)=\pi_0(f)\sum_j
 \frac{d_j\{f(j)-r_j\}}{r_j(1-r_j)},
 \qquad \pi_b(f)=\pi_0(f)+b\delta(f).
\tag{9}
\]
Independence under \(\pi_0\) gives \(\sum_f\delta(f)=0\) and
\[
 \sum_f\pi_b(f)f(j)=r_j+bd_j.
\tag{10}
\]
The smallest possible value of the sum multiplying \(b\) in (9) is
\(-16/3-4-12=-64/3\).  Thus \(0<b<1/32\) implies
\(\pi_b(f)>\pi_0(f)/3>0\) for every table.  Equations (9)--(10) give a rational-affine primitive-coordinate map inside the full canonical response simplex, not merely prescribed row marginals.

From \(S=R_0\mathbin\oplus N_S\),
\[
 P(S=0\mid R_0=0)=2/3,\quad P(S=0\mid R_0=1)=1/3,
\]
with the two probabilities reversed for \(S=1\).  In the natural context,
\(P(A=1\mid U_0=0)=1/4\) and \(P(A=1\mid U_0=1)=3/4\).  Therefore the coefficient of \(b\) in \(P(S=0,A=1,Y=1)\) is
\[
 \frac14\frac23\{\tfrac14(-4)+\tfrac34(0)\}
 +\frac14\frac13\{\tfrac14(-1)+\tfrac34(3)\}=0,
\tag{11}
\]
and, in the forced context \(A=1\), the coefficient is
\[
 \frac14\frac13(-4+0)+\frac14\frac23(-1+3)=0.
\tag{12}
\]
No \(A=0\) row is perturbed; equality of the \(Y=0\) cells follows from the unchanged \((S,A)\) margins.  Direct summation at \(b=0\) gives
\[
 (13,11,13,11,24,24)/96.
\tag{13}
\]
Equations (11)--(12) show that (13) holds throughout the box.  Its minimum is \(11/96>0\), and appending independent fair \(W_0,Z_0\) multiplies each full cell by \(1/4\).  Also \(P(S=0)=P(S=1)=1/2\), so support is exactly \(H\).

Under \(do(A=1,S=s_{\emptyset})\), \((U_0,R_0)\) remains uniform and
\[
 T_b(Y=1)=\frac12+b\frac{-4-1+0+3}{4}
 =\frac12-\frac b2.
\tag{14}
\]
The observation identities (11)--(13), the strict simplex and cell inequalities, exact selector support, and the constant-sign contrast (14) are exactly the residual verifier's tests.  Hence it accepts.  At \(b=1/64\), (14) gives \(63/128\), whereas the fixed model at \(b=0\) gives \(1/2\).
body.justification: The example now follows the genuine deterministic path through Algorithm 2 to its unclassified line-9 failure and only then obtains nonidentification from an independently verified affine response contrast.
body.gap: The former hand-installed four-token trace exercised obsolete operations and was not generated by the LGS case splitter.
body.consumer: The exact cells, affine canonical table path, failure tag, and target contrast form a regression fixture for the redesigned backend.
